title: Choosing an algorithmic fairness metric for an online marketplace: Detecting and quantifying algorithmic bias on LinkedIn
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmark related to faith or religion. The methodology presented is for detecting algorithmic bias in general, but the empirical application is exclusively focused on gender bias in recommendation algorithms on LinkedIn.
findings: This paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion. The study's focus is on developing a fairness metric and applying it to detect gender bias.
